title: Return Windows, Methods and Ship-By Terms for Marketplace Orders
content:
The return terms of Marketplace Orders differ by delivery option. For each option the table states the return window in calendar days after the delivered date, whether the holiday return calendar extends it, which item categories cannot be returned for a refund, which return methods a return request may use besides returnless, and how long the buyer has to get the item its first carrier scan.

## Return windows

| Delivery option | Standard return window (new and used items) | Renewed-condition return window | Holiday extension applies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | 30 | 90 | Yes |
| Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping | 30 | 90 | Yes |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Standard | 30 | 90 | Yes |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day | 30 | 90 | Yes |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | 30 | 90 | Yes |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | 30 | 90 | No |

**Holiday return calendar (every option):** orders delivered from 11-01 to 12-31 (1 November to 31 December, both inclusive) may be returned until 01-31 (31 January) of the following calendar year. The calendar extends the deadline only on options where the holiday extension applies.

**Non-returnable item category (every option):** grocery.

## Return methods and ship-by terms

| Delivery option | Return methods allowed besides returnless | Ship-by days after the return request | Late grace days after the ship-by deadline |
|---|---|---|---|
| Seller Fulfilled Standard Shipping | UPS drop-off | 14 | 15 |
| Seller Fulfilled Expedited Shipping | UPS drop-off | 14 | 15 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Standard | UPS drop-off, carrier pickup | 30 | 15 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Two-Day | UPS drop-off, carrier pickup | 30 | 15 |
| Fulfilled by Northloop Same-Day | UPS drop-off, carrier pickup | 30 | 15 |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | freight pickup | 14 | 0 |

The ship-by days are the calendar days after the return request within which the returned item must receive its first carrier scan. The late grace days are the calendar days after that ship-by deadline during which a late first scan is still accepted with a deduction; a figure of 0 means late returns are rejected.

## Points of reading

- A renewed-condition item on any option has 90 days; a new or used item has 30.
- Large Item Freight Delivery is the only option without the holiday extension and without a late grace period.
- Carrier pickup is offered only on the three Fulfilled by Northloop options; freight pickup only on Large Item Freight Delivery.
